description: This Java source file defines the UtilCacheEvents class, which contains static methods for handling web events related to cache management in the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for removing cache elements, clearing caches, updating cache settings, and handling multiple cache operations via HTTP requests.

classes.name: UtilCacheEvents
classes.description: Contains static methods for handling cache-related web events in the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: removeElementEvent
methods.description: Removes a specific element from a named cache based on HTTP request parameters.

methods.name: clearEvent
methods.description: Clears a specified cache based on HTTP request parameters.

methods.name: clearAllEvent
methods.description: Clears all caches if the user has permission.

methods.name: clearSelectedCachesEvent
methods.description: Clears multiple selected caches based on form input.

methods.name: updateEvent
methods.description: Updates cache settings such as max in memory, expire time, and soft reference usage.
